$comment: OCBC's published help page 'Adding card to mobile wallet' (Decisions 5 and 7). A published page, not contract terms. One clause per question with its answer; the help menu before the article and the trademark notices after it are left out. ocbc.com refuses automated requests, so every version here is an Internet Archive capture; today's page waits for a browser capture by a person (blocked-sources.md). effective_from is the capture date (the page shows no date of its own); the page's own dates ('from 31 July 2025') go on the wallet_provisioning request row. From the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine (capture 2025-08-22; fetched 24 November 2026). The last capture before 1 October 2025 (captures from 26 July 2025 differ only before this one).
